# Mapping verification

<!-- GENERATED by `pnpm verify:mappings:apply` + tools/verify — do not edit by hand. -->

Platform mappings are cross-checked against independently maintained libraries that compile against the real
SDKs. A confirmation means **another library agrees the identifier, record and field exist** — it is not a
device test. Behaviour still needs a real build; see [NATIVE-VERIFICATION.md](NATIVE-VERIFICATION.md).

## Levels of evidence

Not all confirmation is equal. In increasing order of strength:

1. **Cross-reference** — another library that compiles against the SDK uses the same identifier. Cheap and
   broad, but it inherits that library's mistakes.
2. **Compilation** — the generated code builds against the real SDK headers (`pnpm verify:swift`).
3. **Runtime resolution** — the SDK itself resolves the identifier (`swift run healthspec-check`).
4. **Device behaviour** — the call actually returns the right data. Tracked in
   [NATIVE-VERIFICATION.md](NATIVE-VERIFICATION.md); not yet reached.

Level 3 has already overruled level 1 once. `environmental_audio_exposure_event` was "confirmed" against the
header-generated source, which lists `HKCategoryTypeIdentifierEnvironmentalAudioExposureEvent` — a string
HealthKit does not resolve. Apple renamed the Swift case in iOS 14 but kept the raw value
`HKCategoryTypeIdentifierAudioExposureEvent`; the generator had derived the string from the case name. Only
asking the runtime caught it.

## Sources

| Source | Kind | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| `@kingstinct/react-native-healthkit` (`healthkit.generated.ts`) | generated from HealthKit headers | quantity + category identifiers, category raw values, read-only flags |
| `react-native-health` (Objective-C + `index.d.ts`) | hand-written bindings | correlation and clinical identifiers |
| `react-native-health-connect` (Kotlin) | hand-written bindings | Health Connect record classes and field names |
| the Swift runtime itself | authoritative | every quantity and category identifier, via `HKObjectType.…(forIdentifier:)` |

## Coverage

| Platform | Mappings | Confirmed | Share |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Apple HealthKit | 167 | 159 | 95% |
| Android Health Connect | 53 | 41 | 77% |

## Not confirmed

These mappings have no cross-checkable source. Most are non-`TypeIdentifier` HealthKit data (ECG, heartbeat
series, State of Mind, workouts, activity summaries, medications) or Health Connect Personal Health Record
resources — APIs the comparison libraries do not implement at all.
